summary: Four small skills that take a sentence to a judged pull request, run many goals in parallel from one watching session, and cut draft releases. No engine: Markdown instructions and three stdlib Python scripts.
use_cases: Take one sentence to a reviewed pull request
Run several goals in parallel and see what waits on you
Have a fresh agent judge a change it did not write
Cut a draft GitHub release with a changelog
Set up a repo's workflow config safely on a branch
writes: run state under the git common dir, in loop/ (never committed)
git worktrees under that loop/ folder
git branches loop/<slug> and workflow-setup, commits on them
VERSION and CHANGELOG.md on a goal's branch when you cut
network: github.com (git push, gh pull request and draft release calls, only when you run them)
the model host your own claude or codex command already uses
